note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase / PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources beside it. Anything the official description does not pin down — a place, a step, a count — is labelled 'not yet checked in-game' and never guessed.

trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it — work the roadmap in order (story first, then strangers and contacts, then collectibles, then activities and money, then cleanup) and this is the last track on the board. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for its place as the list's single platinum.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (platinum, 1 of 55)

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission on the board, so it should pop early in a normal playthrough — just play the story from the start and do not skip the opening. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the mission listing.
trophies.missableRule: Story-gated: tied to one named mission (Gone Fishing). Missable only if that mission cannot be replayed — not yet checked in-game whether mission replay exists.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock someone down. It is a driving-combat trick, so find a quiet stretch, line up a target and swing as you pass; the 'ten pin' name is a bowling joke, not a bowling requirement. How many need to fall at once is not yet checked in-game. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the activity listing.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts wash them into clean money — keep laundering through them until the total hits $250,000. Which contacts launder and what cut they take is not yet checked in-game. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the count of $250,000.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — every shop counts toward one total, so just buy what you need as you play and let it add up. Big purchases (vehicles, weapons, clothes) move it fastest; there is no need to waste money, since normal play spending counts. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the count of $100,000.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — PSNProfiles lists 8. Where the 8 garages are and what they cost is not yet checked in-game. Sources: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the count of 8.
